Rendered the full Home mega-menu via Playwright (comprehensive __NEXT_DATA__-backed nav: Bath, Bedding, Home Decor, Candles & Diffusers, Tabletop & Dining, Dorm Room Essentials, Electronics & Speakers, Fall Home, Halloween Decor, Healthy Living, Kitchen, Luggage & Travel Bags, Outdoor Living, Pantry Food & Candy, Pet Accessories, Travel Essentials, Water Bottles & Tumblers, Home Gifts, Nordstrom Made, Home Sale, New Arrivals, Under $100) -> only Fall Home and Halloween Decor are seasonal in the live nav. Also scanned the sitemap index (content-sitemap.xml + all 24 navigation-filter-sitemap-N.xml files) for /browse/home seasonal slugs: the only seasonal-looking hits were brand-filter facets (Mr. Christmas, Mr. Halloween, Frances Valentine, Winterborne Decor, Eastern Woven) on ordinary categories, not distinct seasonal category pages -- excluded as brand facets, not categories. Guessed and checked additional candidate slugs: /browse/home/christmas, /browse/home/holiday, /browse/home/holiday-shop, /browse/home/thanksgiving all resolve to a real (non-blocked) but empty/no-content page (just a charity banner, no H1, no product grid, no breadcrumb) -- treated as not real categories, i.e. absent. /browse/home/valentine, /browse/home/easter, /browse/home/new-year return true HTTP 404. /browse/home/holiday-decor DOES resolve to a genuine, fully populated Category-template PLP (breadcrumb Home/Home/Holiday Decor, page title 'Holiday and Christmas Decor | Nordstrom', product grid exclusively Christmas trees/ornaments/stockings/wreaths) even though it is not currently one of the tabs in the live Home sub-nav strip (likely pre-season, not yet promoted into nav) -- included per Task criteria (genuine PLP, own URL, site names it 'Holiday Decor' which is an explicit Christmas discovery term in the ruleset). No Diwali/Eid/Holi/other South-Asian festival categories exist anywhere in Home nav (expected for a US department store; not fabricated). No Thanksgiving, Valentine's Day, Easter, New Year, or generic 'Holiday Shop' category currently exists under Home. Left-nav/facet inspection on Holiday Decor and Halloween Decor showed only generic Product Type / Brand / Price / Color / Size facets (Candle Holders, Decorative Accents, Lighting, etc.) -- these are filter facets, not separate PLP sub-categories, so not extracted as separate rows.
